name: qb-core
author: u-core (TS port of qbcore-framework/qb-core)
description: u-core TS port of qb-core. Server: Functions/Player/Events/Exports/Debug/Lang. Client: Functions/Events/Loops/DrawText/Lang. Vehicle-properties getters/setters cover the core fields only (model/plate/health/fuel/dirt/colors). Locale system ships the Locale class + the en.lua phrase tree; downstream consumers reach phrases via QBCore.Lang.t(key, subs) on either side. Replaces the upstream qbcore-framework/qb-core download in the txAdmin recipe — see txadmin/recipe.yaml.
